{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the column name is 'severity' (lowercase)
column_name = df.columns[4]  # 'severity' is the 5th column
print(f"Column name: {column_name}")

# Check unique values
severity_unique = df['severity'].unique()
print(f"Unique severity values: {severity_unique}")

# Filter for patients with 'severe' (lowercase)
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Count total SEVERE patients
n_severe = len(df_severe)

# Identify sentinel values (-999.0) in baseline biomarker
sentinel_values = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]
n_sentinel = len(sentinel_values)

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of SEVERE patients: {n_severe}")
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999.0) among SEVERE patients: {n_sentinel}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker_severe}")"}
